themes_detail.label: Street Infrastructure Deterioration
themes_detail.summary: Dangling street signs spiked to 6 complaints THIS WEEK versus 1.0 weekly average (z-score: 7.07), and commercial disposal complaints hit 4 THIS WEEK versus 0.6 weekly average (z-score: 6.97), suggesting rapid infrastructure decay across the district that poses safety and sanitation risks.
evidence: Street Sign - Dangling complaints: 6 THIS WEEK vs. 1.0 weekly baseline (500% spike, z-score 7.07)
Commercial Disposal complaints: 4 THIS WEEK vs. 0.6 weekly baseline (540% spike, z-score 6.97)
Both spikes emerged simultaneously within the same reporting period, suggesting systemic neglect
reporting_angles: Site visit to document dangling signs and ask DOT why maintenance response has lagged
Interview small business owners about commercial disposal problems and whether they've requested city pickup services

themes_detail.label: Litter Crisis Emerging
themes_detail.summary: Litter basket complaints exploded to 4 THIS WEEK versus 0.1 weekly average over 8 weeks (3100% spike, z-score: 11.72—the highest statistical anomaly in the dataset), indicating a potential sanitation collapse in public spaces.
evidence: Litter Basket complaints: 4 THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly average (3100% spike, z-score 11.72—highest anomaly in dataset)
Abandoned Bike complaints: 3 last week vs. 0.1 weekly average (2300% spike, z-score 8.69), suggesting general public space neglect
Dirty Condition complaints remain elevated at 471 over 90 days, indicating ongoing sanitation stress
reporting_angles: Walk the district to photograph overflowing litter baskets and abandoned bikes; quantify coverage gaps
Contact DSNY to understand if staffing shortages or collection schedule changes triggered the spike

themes_detail.label: Outdoor Dining & Noise Clustering
themes_detail.summary: Outdoor Dining complaints jumped to 6 LAST WEEK versus 0.5 weekly average (1100% spike, z-score: 6.35), and Noise - House of Worship complaints hit 3 LAST WEEK versus 0.2 weekly average (1100% spike, z-score: 6.35), suggesting conflicts between new commercial activity and residential/institutional quality of life.
evidence: Outdoor Dining complaints: 6 last week vs. 0.5 weekly average (1100% spike, z-score 6.35)
Noise - House of Worship complaints: 3 last week vs. 0.2 weekly average (1100% spike, z-score 6.35)
Residential Noise remains high at 1401 complaints over 90 days, suggesting a broader noise environment crisis
reporting_angles: Identify which outdoor dining venues are generating complaints and whether they have proper permits/sound mitigation
Interview affected houses of worship about noise disturbances and whether they've contacted 311 or community board

themes_detail.label: Parking & Driveway Obstruction Crisis (Chronic)
themes_detail.summary: Illegal Parking (4388 complaints) and Blocked Driveway (1620 complaints) dominate 90-day complaint volume, indicating a sustained and severe accessibility problem that affects residents daily; while not spiking THIS WEEK, the sheer volume and lack of resolution signals systemic failure.
evidence: Illegal Parking: 4388 complaints over 90 days (highest category by far)
Blocked Driveway: 1620 complaints over 90 days (second-highest category)
Combined total of 6008 complaints suggests enforcement gap or insufficient parking supply
reporting_angles: Map complaint hotspots to identify streets with chronic blockage and interview residents about impact on emergency access
Obtain NYPD Parking Enforcement citation data to determine if enforcement matches complaint volume

themes_detail.label: Rezoning Pipeline & Gentrification Risk
themes_detail.summary: Three active ULURP applications (1417 Avenue U, 2555 Shell Road, 2959 Avenue Y) are in progress with limited visible community board data or public discussion, suggesting potential gap in resident awareness during a period of rapid 90-day permit activity (603 DOB filings).
evidence: 1417 Avenue U Rezoning: In Public Review (EAS - City Council Review stage)
2555 Shell Road Rezoning: Filed (ZM - Prepare Filed Land Use Application stage)
2959 Avenue Y Rezoning: Noticed (ZM - Review Filed Land Use Application stage)
603 DOB building permits filed in last 90 days (373 alterations, 86 new buildings, 17 demolitions) indicate active development pressure
reporting_angles: Attend City Council review for 1417 Avenue U and document testimony from residents and elected officials
Interview community board members and local groups about whether they are adequately resourced to review three simultaneous rezonings
